segments.t: 翻译：种花小医杂家赵 一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者，欢迎勘误。 YUNNANENSIS Synonyms : Crassula yunnanensis  Franchet (1896) / Sedum indicum var. yunnanensis (Franchet) Hamet (1913) Sedum pyramidale  Franchet  ms. ex Hamet (1929) Sedum pyramidatum Franchet in sched. ex Hamet (1929) Distribution : W China (Yunnan), 2500 – 2700 m. Description (according to IHSP, 2003) : Rosettes dense, 2.5 – 3.75 cm in diameter, with 50 – 70 leaves. Leaves oblanceolate to spatulate, almost terete, very thick, lower face very convex, upper face somewhat flat to convex, acute or acuminate, gradually mucronate, 12.5 – 25 x 4.5 – 6 mm, dark bluish-green, with dense purple mottling, turning black in full sun, densely pubescent with short white hairs especially on young leaves and over both faces (or at least in the upper part and on the margins), hairs linear-deltoid, patent or slightly deflexed. Inflorescenses dense, flattish, densely leafy, 5 – 10 x 4 – 5 cm, finely papillose, lover bracts opposite but few, pedicels very short, shortly pubescent or papillose. Flowers to 6 mm, narrowed towards the inflorescence tip, sepals rather narrow, 1.8 x 1 mm, papillose, petals oblong-lanceolate, not thickened, more erect at the base (so that the flowers are rather narrow), 3 – 4 x 1.5 mm, light yellowish, with orange-red flush in full sun, papillose on the outside. 失效名： Crassula yunnanensis  Franchet (1896) / Sedum indicum var. yunnanensis (Franchet) Hamet (1913) Sedum pyramidale  Franchet  ms. ex Hamet (1929) Sedum pyramidatum Franchet in sched. ex Hamet (1929) 分布：中国西部（云南） ，海拔2500 - 2700米。 形态描述（根据2003 IHSP ） ： 莲座密集丛生，单个莲座直径约2.5 - 3.75厘米，生长有50 - 70片叶片。 叶序呈倒披针形排列。叶片匙形，几乎是圆柱状的，较厚。叶背面凸出，正面略有凹陷，先端急尖或渐渐收成一个短尖。叶片12.5 - 25毫米长，4.5 - 6毫米宽，深蓝绿色，表面有密集的紫色斑点。叶片在充足日照下会变成黑色，表面生长出白色的茂密短绒。在嫩叶上较明显，两面均有柔毛（或至少延伸叶片正面的边缘）。hairs linear-deltoid, patent or slightly deflexed(这句话实在翻译不出来啊摔……)。 花序密集，（顶端）平，花序上着生密集的小叶，花序约 5 - 10 ×4 - 5厘米大小。具细小叶苞片。lover bracts opposite but few（又是一句翻不出来的摔……）。花梗短，被短柔毛或小叶。 花6毫米大小，在花序末端收窄。萼片非常细小， 1.8 ×1毫米，乳突状。花瓣长圆状披针形，薄。花序中部的花朵倾向于集中生长，使得花朵间距极小。单花3 - 4毫米长，1.5毫米宽。花色淡黄色，阳光充足处花色会呈现橙红色，花朵外侧包绕小苞片叶。 NOTE: 感谢新浪微博花友CC1005补充 滇石莲以及所有的SINO属石莲花，都有开花后主头死亡的特性，这点和莲花掌属，瓦松属，长生草属是一样的。
